about_the_game:
Kindred Spirits is a Fully Voice Acted RPG Maker Game with a fun and thrilling story to keep you in the game!

GAME FEATURES

- Respectable-But-Challenging Turn-Based combat!

- Fun and Lovable characters!

- Steam Achievements!

- And fun easter eggs!
